reference.title: Build parameters
reference.shortdesc: Parameters are passed on the command line as -Dname=value, or in a DITA-OT project file.

row.entry: Parameter
Values
Purpose
neutral (default), istanduk, nhs, official

Branding mode. The iStandUK theme layers brand colours and the logo on top of neutral; nhs applies the NHS Design System palette and header, and official the full GOV.UK crown branding — each for the entitled organisation only. See .
text
The name in the masthead and footer. Defaults to the map title, or a bookmap's main book title.
text
Shows a GOV.UK phase banner above the content with this tag, for example alpha or beta. Empty (default) shows no banner. Works in every branding mode.
text
Feedback link shown in the phase banner (used only when govuk.phase is set). Empty shows the banner text without a link.
text
Target of the masthead home link. Empty (default) links to the generated site's own home page.
text
Path to a favicon (.ico, .png or .svg) to copy into the output and link from every page. Empty ships no favicon.
text
Extra footer links as a ;-separated list of label|url pairs, for example Privacy|https://…/privacy;Contact|https://…/contact.
text
auto (default), start, annotated, list, grid, grouped, accordion
Landing-page layout. auto chooses from the map's shape; see .
1–9; default 2
How many levels of the map the landing page shows (grid, grouped, accordion, and start layouts): 1 lists top-level entries only, 2 adds their children, higher values nest deeper.
auto (default), yes, no
Site search; see .
path
Location of the Pagefind executable when it is not on the PATH.
default (default), reference, or a JSON object

How search results are scored. reference ranks exact-title pages first (raw term counts, no long-page penalty), which suits dictionaries, catalogues and standards; a JSON object passes Pagefind ranking options through unchanged. See .
yes (default), no
Inline local SVG diagrams as native SVG so links inside them work; no keeps the image rendering.
no (default), yes
whole number; default 500
Largest publication, in topic files, for which the print document is written; above it the build warns (GOVK003W) and writes none.
1–9; default 3
How many map levels the print document's contents list shows.
A4 (default), A5, A3, B5, B4, JIS-B5, JIS-B4, Letter, Legal, Ledger, or a width and height such as 148mm 210mm
Paper size the print stylesheet asks for (and, from 1.1, the PDF page size).
a command; empty by default

Render the print document as PDF with a CSS Paged Media formatter you have installed. The print document's path and the output path are appended as the last two arguments. A formatter resolves the page references browsers cannot — page numbers in the contents, the index and cross-references. Failure is reported (GOVK008W) and the site is still complete; see .
file name; default the map's name
Name for the generated PDF, without the extension.
portrait (default), landscape
Page orientation with a named paper size; explicit lengths are already width then height.
yes (default), no

Remove active content — script, foreignObject, event-handler attributes, script-scheme links, references to other origins — from inlined SVG diagrams; no inlines the file as authored. Findings are reported either way (GOVK004W); see .
input (default), any
Where inlined SVG and MathML may come from: only under the input directory, or anywhere the reference points. A reference outside the input directory is reported (GOVK005W).
yes (default), no
Report script-scheme links, images and objects fetched from another origin, and object embeds as build warnings (GOVK006W). The build never fails on content.
warn (default), strip
What happens to the content the warnings report: rendered as authored, or replaced with a marked placeholder carrying its alt text or description.
no (default), meta, or a policy

A Content-Security-Policy on every page. meta emits one the plugin's pages satisfy — same-origin resources only, the single constant inline script by hash (the Design System's own body-class snippet, so the hash is the one it publishes), WebAssembly for search — as a meta element, for hosts without header control; a literal value is emitted as given. Content the policy would block is reported (GOVK007W). Hosts that can set headers should prefer a header, which can also carry frame-ancestors.
URL
The published base URL, for example https://example.org/manual/. Needed for sitemap.xml, whose entries must be absolute.
auto (default), yes, no

Write sitemap.xml — the cover, every navigable topic page, the glossary, index and list pages; not the search page or the print document — and a robots.txt pointing at it unless one already exists. auto writes it when govuk.site.url is set.
no (default), updated, both

Show a topic's critdates as a metadata line beneath its summary: the last revised date (or the created date when there is none), or both. The date shown is only as good as its source — publications whose dates are batch-stamped by tooling should leave this off. When on, revised dates also become lastmod in the sitemap.
Further parameters — phase banner, footer links, favicon — arrive with their features; each is listed here when it lands.
